reasons: Candidate measures redis.clients.connected, but the Datadog query is sum of redis.clients.blocked. Connected and blocked clients are different quantities, so the metric is wrong.
The Datadog host template variable (prefix host, default *) should become a host matcher on the translated selector, but the candidate has none. The series set therefore differs.
The scope variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct. The key variable is unused by the query and needs no matcher.

No OTel metric in the supplied definitions measures blocked clients. If none exists in the catalog, the correct outcome is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, not a translation to a different metric.
